name: Control of Robotic Systems
description: Rotation and homogeneous transformations, DH-convention, forward and inverse kinematics, inverse kinematics, velocity kinematics, holonomic and non-holonomic constraints, path and trajectory planning, robot dynamics, robot control: linear methods – feedforward control, state feedback, observers; nonlinear control methods – computed torque control, vision based robotic control. Non-linear control and geometric control, mobile robots.
